citations.excerpt: On the 28th of January, 1521, Charles V. opened his first Diet at Worms.

facts.value: Imperial diet under Charles V before which Luther was cited to appear after his excommunication.

citations.excerpt: At the very beginning of the Diet a new papal brief called upon the Emperor to give, by an imperial edict, legal force to the bull of January 3, by which Luther was finally excommunicated
he cited Luther to appear before the Diet within twenty-one days under the sure protection of the Empire.

facts.value_before_verify: Imperial assembly under Charles V before which Luther appeared after his excommunication.
